en: Colorized vintage view of a wide, tree-lined avenue in a forest or landscaped park. Tall trees form a canopy over a straight dirt path that leads toward a classical stone archway in the distance. In the foreground are three seated men and one standing man with a tripod-mounted camera, while further along the path a woman and a child with a pram are visible. At the bottom, red German text is printed.
